module_summary: PicoRV32 RISC-V core wrapped with a Wishbone master: a 3-state FSM latches the core's native memory request onto Wishbone signals, waits for ack, and returns read data with a one-cycle mem_ready.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: IDLE/WBSTART/WBEND bridge FSM sequencing Wishbone cycles.

anchors.name: wbm_cyc_o
anchors.why: Wishbone cycle asserted on core request until ack.

anchors.name: wbm_ack_i
anchors.why: Wishbone ack ends cycle, captures read data and moves FSM.

anchors.name: wbm_adr_o
anchors.why: Wishbone address latched from core mem_addr.

anchors.name: wbm_stb_o
anchors.why: Wishbone strobe asserted with cyc during WBSTART.

anchors.name: wbm_dat_o
anchors.why: Wishbone write data latched from core mem_wdata.

anchors.name: wbm_dat_i
anchors.why: Wishbone read data captured into mem_rdata on ack.

anchors.name: wbm_we_o
anchors.why: Wishbone write enable from any nonzero strobe.

anchors.name: wbm_sel_o
anchors.why: Wishbone byte selects latched from mem_wstrb.

anchors.name: mem_valid
anchors.why: Core memory request starting a Wishbone cycle in IDLE.

anchors.name: mem_ready
anchors.why: One-cycle completion pulse back to the core.

anchors.name: mem_rdata
anchors.why: Holds Wishbone read data returned to the core.

anchors.name: we
anchors.why: Write decode from OR of mem_wstrb bits.

anchors.name: mem_wstrb
anchors.why: Core byte write strobes, drive we and wbm_sel_o.

anchors.name: mem_instr
anchors.why: Indicates current core memory access is instruction fetch.

anchors.name: pcpi_valid
anchors.why: Coprocessor request valid; PCPI disabled by default.

anchors.name: irq
anchors.why: Interrupt request inputs; IRQ disabled by default.

anchors.name: trace_valid
anchors.why: Trace output valid; trace disabled by default.

groups.name: PicoRV32 core
groups.description: Multi-cycle RISC-V core issuing native valid/ready memory requests.

groups.name: Wishbone bridge FSM
groups.description: Converts core request into one Wishbone cycle and returns ready/rdata.

groups.name: Wishbone master port
groups.description: Registered Wishbone address, data, select, strobe and cycle outputs.

groups.name: Coprocessor, IRQ and trace
groups.description: Optional core side interfaces passed through to ports.
